input: Find founder- or family-owned US veterinary clinic groups with 5-30 locations

companies.name: Healthy Pets of Ohio
companies.employees: 201–500 employee range; matched current headcount 11 (FullEnrich company match; as_of 2026-11-09; the two measures conflict, so treat as a broad estimate)

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company describes itself as Central Ohio's largest independent veterinary practice and lists eight animal hospitals; the locations page states the group grew from 1 to 8 locations. as_of 2026-11-09.
The company says it is proudly family-owned and locally operated since 1952; its history identifies Dr. Hal Taylor Sr. as founder and describes three generations of Taylor family leadership.
The company says every decision is guided by patients, not corporate ownership, and calls itself independent.
FullEnrich's exact LinkedIn-company match returns company type Privately Held, headcount 11 and headcount range 201–500; because those fields conflict, the range is reported as the broad estimate.

companies.traction: Eight thriving clinics; the most recent clinic, Healthy Pets of Houk Road, opened in 2024. source_url: https://www.healthypetsofohio.com/our-history/; as_of 2026-11-09.
companies.rank_reason: Best fit: exact 8-location scale, explicit family ownership, three-generation founder-family continuity, and explicit independence from corporate ownership; employee data is the main diligence gap.

companies.name: Noah's Ark Animal Clinics
companies.employees: 57 matched company employees; 51–200 range (FullEnrich exact LinkedIn-company match; as_of 2026-11-09)

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company's locations page lists five clinics: Springdale, Colerain, West Chester, Ft. Wright, and Florence, all in the Greater Cincinnati area. as_of 2026-11-09.

The company describes itself as an independent, family-owned and family-operated pet healthcare network; its history traces the Lies family legacy from Dr. George Lies through Dr. John Lies and owner/president Dr. Mike Lies.
The company expressly describes the network as independent and family-owned/family-operated; no PE sponsor is identified on the opened company pages.
FullEnrich's exact LinkedIn-company match returns 57 employees and a 51–200 range; as_of 2026-11-09.

companies.traction: The group states it has five locations and has served the Cincinnati area for over 60 years; its history also describes a veterinary legacy beginning in 1914. source_url: https://noahsarkanimalclinics.com/about-us/; as_of 2026-11-09.
companies.rank_reason: Strong fit: five-location network, unusually clear family ownership and multi-generation continuity, plus the strongest available group-level employee estimate; current dated headcount history and funding disclosure remain gaps.

companies.name: Symbios Animal Health
companies.employees: 1 Datalegion corporate-profile employee estimate; LinkedIn estimate 2 (observed 2025-08; exact-domain match; not a clinic-staff census)

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company states that it is a family of six independently owned New Jersey animal hospitals and lists six hospitals in the Symbios family. as_of 2026-11-09.

The company says every hospital is 100% independently and family owned; it also describes the hospitals as owned by working veterinarians and identifies multiple owners, including Nick and Elizabeth Pope and Jan Cailles.
The company explicitly says it has no corporate parent and no outside investors.
Datalegion matched the exact symbios.vet domain and returned 1 current corporate-profile employee, LinkedIn estimate 2, with the latest monthly observation 2025-08.

companies.headcount_growth: 1 (2022-07) to 1 (2025-08), 0% net growth in Datalegion's corporate-profile history; this is not a census of all six hospital teams.
companies.traction: Six independently owned New Jersey animal hospitals operating as one family. source_url: https://www.symbios.vet/; as_of 2026-11-09.
companies.rank_reason: Clearest no-PE/family-ownership evidence and in-range six-hospital footprint, but weaker fit confidence because the available headcount data appears to cover only the corporate profile and no founding year or funding history was disclosed.

companies.name: Community Veterinary Clinic
companies.employees: 1 Datalegion exact-domain employee estimate; LinkedIn estimate 2 (observed 2025-08; matched record is labeled Community Veterinary Clinic: Dublin and likely undercounts the five-location group)

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The history page says the practice grew into a locally and family-owned network of five locations—Sidney, Troy, Piqua, Dublin, and Plain City—in West-Central Ohio. as_of 2026-11-09.
The company says the story began in 1992 when Dr. Current opened the first clinic, identifies him as owner and founder, and calls the network locally and family-owned.
The company says it remains proudly family-owned and is not bound by corporate policies.

Datalegion matched the exact domain but labeled the record Community Veterinary Clinic: Dublin and returned 1 current corporate-profile employee and LinkedIn estimate 2; this is reported as a likely undercount rather than a group census.

companies.headcount_growth: 1 (2023-05) to 1 (2025-08), no net growth in Datalegion's exact-domain history; the matched single-location label makes this unreliable for the five-location group.
companies.traction: Five-location network with more than 30 years of service; the history page also includes customer testimonials. source_url: https://mycommunityveterinaryclinic.com/history/; as_of 2026-11-09.
companies.rank_reason: Qualifies cleanly on five locations, 1992 founder continuity, and explicit family ownership, but ranks fourth because group-level headcount and financing data are not reliably available.

output.search_notes: Screened company sites, location pages, ownership/history pages, LinkedIn-company results, and funding/news pages. Excluded Pieper Veterinary because its April 18, 2023 announcement says it partnered with Chicago Pacific Founders, a private-equity firm; excluded VetRoots because the opened page supports veterinarian-owned rather than founder-/family-owned; excluded Neighborhood Vet Hospitals because the opened site lists four locations (below the five-location minimum). The Pet Vet was not included: FullEnrich returned an older veterinary-group LinkedIn record, but the current thepetvet.com page opened in this run is an ESA-letter business, creating an exact-entity conflict. Missing or weak fields across qualifying companies: current dated headcount series for Healthy Pets and Noah's Ark, reliable group-level headcount for Symbios and Community, and disclosed funding rounds. No qualifying company page opened in this run disclosed a last funding round. All numeric claims should be read with their as_of notes; current website facts are as_of 2026-11-09 unless an earlier observation is explicitly stated.
